name: Mednafen
description:
Mednafen is a portable, multi-system command-line emulator utilizing OpenGL and SDL. Known for exceptional emulation accuracy, it supports a wide variety of retro console and handheld systems.

Features:
- Emulates PlayStation 1, Sega Saturn, PC Engine / TurboGrafx-16, and Neo Geo Pocket
- Accurate Nintendo emulation for NES, SNES, Game Boy, Game Boy Color, and GBA
- Sega Genesis, Master System, Game Gear, and WonderSwan support
- Robust netplay architecture with rewind capabilities and save state management
- Advanced video filters, custom shader support, and multi-controller mapping
